paired.scope: Actual pinned pnpm metadata selection including registry root-name authority; native acquisition has a distinct Python ABI adaptation.

verification_scope_reason: A real TLS registry serves metadata and an SRI-pinned tarball. Bind requested own-name identity and exact version, require the native Python ABI before acquisition, independently validate the downloaded package descriptor/release source and host compatibility, then feed the same original verified archive to the native store and execute its tool through canonical boot. Incorrect metadata identity/version/ABI/engines refuses before archive transfer; invalid integrity, archive name/version/engines/syntax and undeclared files refuse before profile mutation. Exact-version exemptions apply independently to metadata and actual archive. Signed queries are excluded from acquisition receipts. The original pnpm root-name authority is verified by an added real comparison. Final-byte reads now recheck the total deadline; two focused real HTTP cases prevent late-completed metadata/archive reads from succeeding.
legal_adaptation: Native registry installation deliberately refuses npm aliases and packages without the supported Python ABI before code import; read-only alias metadata remains supported. Metadata visibility is not executable compatibility. Artifact archives are temporary and removed at context exit, while original archive size/digest/integrity provenance remains tied to installation records.
activation_boundary: Registry acquisition validation is complete; a stopped-profile native store/boot journey is verified. Running-host transaction coordination, registry acquisition command composition, production promotion and final browser/release qualification remain pending.
